item.title: Self-Hosted Network Event Correlation: Zenoss vs Icinga vs Zabbix (2026)
item.description: Network event correlation is the process of analyzing multiple monitoring alerts to identify root causes, suppress noise, and provide actionable insights. In a typical enterprise network with hundreds of devices and thousands of metrics, a single network failure can trigger dozens or hundreds of individual alerts. Event correlation transforms this alert flood into a single, meaningful incident.
